ci_wait.head: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
ci_wait.text: Recorded run is held for CI at its recorded head; this wait ends at the CI wait limit at the latest, but failed required checks can still hold it after that, with no time limit; a new head queues a fresh run instead. ci_fixer_first_wait.head: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa

Ledger only (partial). Waiting for: the failed checks to pass or a new head. Recorded earliest recheck: 1970-01-01T00:20:34Z.
